content:
sam_lin: Heads-up — EU GPU onboarding failures rolling in since 08:12 UTC. Lots of nodes stuck in Provisioning -> FailedAttach.
ravi: seen the alerts. any correlation with the firewall change yesterday? :thinking_face:
jonah: yes, we pushed the new restrictive NACL/SG policy to eu-west-1 at 07:50. early signs show node bootstraps can't reach keystore/KMS endpoints.
maya: error logs from node-init show 403 decrypt errors and TLS handshake timeouts to keystore proxy.
jonah: exact log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T08:11:58Z node-init error: KMSDecrypt failed status=403 body="AccessDenied: caller lacks kms:Decrypt on alias/infra-keystore"
```
sam_lin: that explains failures. Is this IAM principal change from the audit hardening rollout? ravi?
ravi: we rolled a tighter role boundary for instance-role at 07:47 to limit s3/list and kms:Encrypt, but KMSDecrypt should have remained. investigating policy diff now.
ci-bot: Deploy 5478 finished (policy-rollout) by sec/ravi at 07:50 UTC — links: https://deploys/redwood/5478
maya: impact: warm-pool cannot prestart ~80 GPU instances, autoscaler is spinning up on-demand and hitting quota/cost spike.
jonah: estimate: extra on-demand = ~24 nodes for 30m -> ~$1.6k burst cost (rough calc). Also cold-start latencies up 3x.
sam_lin: we need a mitigation path that restores provision success without undoing the security intent. Options:
- temporarily allow kms:Decrypt for instance-role from keystore proxy
- add short-lived policy exception to the launch role
- fallback: throttle staging/queued onboarding to avoid cost spike
ravi: prefer policy exception scoped to eu-west-1 keystore proxy and only for instance-role:deployer. I'll craft a tight exception now.
jonah: can we also confirm NAT/egress rules? some nodes show conntrack exhaustion trying to reach privatelink.
maya: conntrack logs show bursts around 08:10 -> matches the policy rollout time. I'll tail natgw metrics and open a ticket if port exhaustion.
ci-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1445 (eu gpu onboarding authz) — assigned to eng-platform
sam_lin: action list:
1) ravi -> push scoped kms:Decrypt exception (eu-west-1, instance-role) — ETA 10m
2) jonah -> run targeted requeue for failed nodes (provision retry) — ETA 15m
3) maya -> monitor natgw conntrack / autoscaler cost delta and throttle if >$2k/1h — ETA 5m
4) sam_lin -> notify customer success if any Dedicated onboarding windows impacted — ETA 20m
ravi: exception pushed to canary edge. policy diff (inline):
```
- Deny: kms:Decrypt for role:instance-role
+ Allow: kms:Decrypt for role:instance-role when resource == arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:alias/infra-keystore-proxy
```
ravi: rolling to eu-west-1. will post when IAM change fully propagated.
jonah: requeued 12 nodes, 7 moved to Running within 4m, 5 still retrying.
maya: autoscaler cost spike stabilizing; added a soft cap for burst to prevent further spend while we confirm boot stability.
sam_lin: good work. next steps: (a) ravi to open PR that documents the scoped exception and timeline for revocation, (b) eng-platform to run a postmortem checklist for rollout sequencing vs egress state.
ravi: PR opened: https://git.redwood/policies/PR-203 (includes automated revoke at 2026-03-20T10:00:00Z). Please review.
maya: monitoring shows warm pool reaching target again, conntrack trending down. marking incident as mitigated.
jonah: will follow up with a small automation to check KMS decrypts during future policy rollouts.
sam_lin: thanks team. closing thread once PR review + postmortem scheduled. :thumbsup:
